decided_by: operator agreed to the session's recommendation
grounds: the line failed hard gate g2 (realized CAGR within +/-30% of the Phase-6B same-period estimate): simulator same-period 2.296%, realized 1.53%, accept band 1.607-2.985%, missed by 0.08 percentage points
the gate and its tolerance were pre-registered in the Phase 7 plan before the window opened

PRELAUNCH1 run after the fact shows the gate was close to unsatisfiable by construction: the +8.08% anchor it was written against sits at the 61st percentile of the strategy's own history, and only 15% of historical 90-day windows would have cleared the +/-30% band at all
lesson_for_future_lines: compute the same-period expectation BEFORE writing a gate against an anchor. The gate here was written against a full-sample figure nobody had converted to the intended window. PRELAUNCH1 (backtest/validation/prelaunch.py) now does this on demand.
what_continues: data collection continues (read-only, free) so the record stays complete. The FundingCarryPaperDaily task is left running.
what_this_does_not_do: does not delete or alter any tracker artifact, funding archive or sealed estimate
does not reverse the Phase 6B research verdict
does not authorize a restart, a retune, or any change to the locked always_on_monthly config
why_not_restart: restarting with a new launch date to obtain a different answer is exactly the false-positive manufacturing the pre-registration framework exists to prevent. The failure is marginal and environmental, but the rule was agreed in advance and it is the rule.
